niche: AI for business — daily updates for time-starved founders and owners, tech and non-tech, focused on what new AI means for running a business
voice: your smart friend who reads the AI news so you don't have to — practical, numbers over adjectives, every story ends with 'what this means for your business', no jargon without translation, confident but not hypey

selection_framework._comment: Replaces the old soft-score ranking. ROUTINE_PROMPT.md Step 3 applies 4 gates + tier tagging in generous mode (over-collect; user filters in dashboard). No hard cap on story count.

tiers.priority: Passes all 4 gates with Gate 3 = 3 (directly on-niche, high business impact, concrete numbers, recognizable name, clear action).
tiers.solid: Passes all 4 gates with Gate 3 = 2 (relevant, worth posting if it fits the week).
tiers.fyi: Passes all 4 gates with Gate 3 = 1 (tangential but kept for context; user decides in dashboard).

deprioritize: pure research papers, benchmarks, architecture debates
developer-only tooling (IDEs, frameworks, libraries, APIs) unless framed for business teams
pure AI drama (lawsuits, departures, board conflicts) without product or pricing impact
speculation or hot takes without grounded evidence
geopolitics, chip supply, infrastructure unless SMB impact within 6 months
